notes.title: Our new game, "The Lotus Holidays" is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]SURPRISE!!![/h1]
After what has been quite a rollercoaster of a year, I am very excited and proud to announce that 
[b]The Lotus Holidays[/b] is finally out for you guys to play and immerse yourself in it!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/D19XHZZ/The-Lotus-Holidays-Hgv-Hd61-RAP.jpg[/img]

It is a stylish single player story-based game, where you win a free weekend at the "Lotus", a luxurious spa resort. But soon, things take a strange and sinister turn.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/F5Wqw33/The-Lotus-Holidays-Y7-UCRx-V5-ZOa.jpg[/img]

It features lots of characters, choices, endings, wild sights (and outfits), and an intricate, interactive story that can unfold in many unexpected ways, given the choices you make and the relationships you build (or not).
It's presented as a neo-noir with sci-fi elements, but ultimately it's a deeply personal tale, holding quite a gut-punch and exciting surprises for those who will stick around to the end.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4MHLGCF/The-Lotus-Holidays-9-SMxg-Y9mp-X.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoy it. 
XX

PS: The original soundtrack will also be available very soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962590/The_Lotus_Holidays/

notes.title: MANGO is fully released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]MANGO is OUT of EARLY ACCESS.[/b][/h1]

After a lot of hard work, we proudly present you Mango in its full glory.

Our biggest thanks to our early bird users, streamers, testers, friends and community for supporting our vision and helping us greatly improve and elevate our game. 

The full version of Mango features ~40 levels, improved mechanics, new cool and/or weird intentional glitches (and jumpscares!),  new settings for Mouse sensibility, Audio and Graphics (Quality preset, FOV slider, VSync, Target frame rate). 

The levels have all been reworked, a lot of them have been re-conceptualized and feature new details, events, animations, reworked puzzles, secrets and/or secret new paths. 11 Achievements have been added, so you can go and have fun chasing them. (If you can! ;) )

Also there is now a log of the notebook entries for our avid readers, and a Spanish/Latin American localization with more of them coming along soon. And the Original Soundtrack is out, too!

ENJOY.

notes.title: MAY/JUNE UPDATE is LIVE!
notes.content:
Tonight we present to you our May + June update on [b]Mango[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IWsqn9S.jpg[/img]

What was originally supposed to be two separate monthly updates, comes together at once for your pleasure.

The story finally reaches its big climax, and it's going to be a complete freakout. What was hinted at and built-upon now comes alive, and as a movie poster would say, 
[b]"There is no escape."[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/391oitA.jpg[/img]

The final 12 levels of the game feature some fairly experimental mechanics, freaky action, even more freaky fashion, nightmares, questionable parenting and also absolute surrealism extravaganza.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GdizUHl.jpg[/img]

Also, a bit of closure.

And debugging.

And a lot of new features like a level selector, FOV settings, a new and improved indicator and interaction system, new achievements and fixes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ds9wrBB.jpg[/img]

Get blasted, be safe!

notes.title: Fixes everywhere
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs.

<3

notes.title: APRIL UPDATE: 9 Brand New Levels, New Achievements + Fixes
notes.content:
Our April Update of [b]Mango[/b] is now live.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jgO1b0c.jpeg[/img]

Through 9 brand new levels, [b]Mango[/b] tells a story about alternate methods of treatment, escape, death, rebirth, denial and acceptance. Almost like life itself, it gets heavenly and hellish in equal measures. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ygz7wEZ.jpg[/img]

Things get even more trippy and twisted. There's some art therapy, train stations, a big "party" in a hospital, a military base, a beautiful penthouse, philosophical meditations and urban surrealism. And also some driving in a vapor-wave cityscape.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nYG8okU.jpeg[/img]

Plenty of bugs have been fixed and new features are coming soon in-between the next monthly update.
Thanks again to our early bird players, please enjoy, share your feedback and stay tuned for more of this madness!

XO

notes.title: March Early Access Update: 8 New Levels + Achievements Added
notes.content:
We proudly present our March Update for [b]Mango[/b].!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vOxkmHK.jpeg[/img]

The next [b]8 levels[/b] are now available in Early Access, featuring a story about airplanes, crashes, recovery and amusement park rides.
Prepare for a fun and trippy ride!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j4EIi5h.jpg[/img]

New features include:
Our first 5 [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[b]Voice-acting[/b] over telephone calls, 
new features and scripting updates
and of course more of the hyper-surrealist imagery and mysterious nature of [b]Mango[/b].

Big thanks to our early testers and people who have left us feedback. It means a lot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NEkii5Z.jpg[/img]

Enjoy everyone and see you next month
<3

notes.title: UPDATE: mouse sensitivity + quality settings, some tweaks and bugs fixed.
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
we just pushed a little update!
Mango now features [b]mouse sensitivity[/b] and [b]graphic quality[/b] settings, which you can find and configure anytime on the [b]Escape Menu[/b], We have also done some optimization, and fixed some bugs that have been reported (or not), in addition with a couple of little tweaks, too.
We hope these updates will improve your gaming experience.
[b]Stay tuned for the major monthly update coming next Thursday (25/3), when the next 8 levels, as well as new features and Steam [i]achievements[/i] are going to be added.[/b]
Thanks everyone who has played and given us feedback! 
XO
